skill.summary: 如何将 memory-lancedb-pro 的记忆文件转换为原版 markdown 格式，并导入到 memos-local-openclaw-plugin 系统中。TRIGGER 当用户提到记忆文件转换、markdown 文件导入、配置文件修改、数据库导入、记忆插件更换、或任何涉及将记忆数据从一个系统迁移到另一...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release: assists users in migrating memory data from memory-lancedb-pro to memos-local-openclaw-plugin.
- Provides step-by-step guidance for converting memory-lancedb-pro files to markdown and importing them into the new system.
- Includes Python scripts for precise configuration file modification and memory file import.
- Documents pitfalls of manual edits and offers automated solutions.
- Lists environment requirements, database schema expectations, and companion import/remove automation scripts.
